==Problem==

What is the smallest possible average of four distinct positive even integers?

<imath>\textbf{(A)}\ 3 \qquad \textbf{(B)}\ 4 \qquad \textbf{(C)}\ 5 \qquad \textbf{(D)}\ 6 \qquad \textbf{(E)}\ 7</imath>


==Solution==
The smallest average is achieved by using the four smallest positive even integers, which are <imath>2</imath>, <imath>4</imath>, <imath>6</imath>, and <imath>8</imath>. 
Their average is <imath>\frac{2+4+6+8}{4}=\frac{20}{4}=\boxed{\textbf{(C)}\ 5}</imath>.
